_readme: THE ONE LIST of our 540 g packs and what can be ordered on our own website. One pack per line: switching a pack on or off for direct orders = changing "sellable" on its line, nothing else. Read by: checkout-worker/src/pricing.js (the Worker prices every order from it and refuses a pack that is not sellable), tools/build_pages.py (product pages, home cards and /checkout/; the build stops if an MRP, size, slug or image here differs from the site) and the checkout page (/checkout/lib/catalogue.js, written by the build). mrp = the MRP printed on the pack, in rupees, incl. of all taxes = the Amazon.in MRP. hsn: only codes on record (blank until the invoice master confirms one). No secrets: served publicly.
